title: Benchmark Tests for Scheduler Hot Paths
description:
Add benchmarks for hot paths:
- `BenchmarkHandlePacket` — full path with mocked deps
- `BenchmarkWorkerSelection` — LeastLoadedStrategy with 100/1000 workers
- `BenchmarkReconciler` — reconcile tick with 500 jobs

**Files**: `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine_bench_test.go`, `core/controlplane/scheduler/strategy_least_loaded_test.go`, `core/controlplane/scheduler/reconciler_test.go`
definitionOfDone: All benchmarks run without error: go test -bench=. -benchmem

implementationPlan.description:
Step 1: Create engine_bench_test.go with BenchmarkHandlePacket

Create `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine_bench_test.go`:
- Setup: fakeBus, SafetyBasic, MemoryRegistry, NaiveStrategy, fakeJobStore
- Benchmark loop: create JobRequest with unique ID, wrap in BusPacket, call HandlePacket
- Use b.ResetTimer() after setup
- Each iteration should exercise the full path: safety check, strategy pick, publish, state transitions
implementationPlan.note: Created engine_bench_test.go with BenchmarkHandlePacket (NaiveStrategy full path), BenchmarkHandleHeartbeat, and BenchmarkHandlePacketWithLeastLoaded (10 registered workers).

implementationPlan.description:
Step 2: Add BenchmarkWorkerSelection to strategy_least_loaded_test.go

In `strategy_least_loaded_test.go`, add two benchmarks:
- `BenchmarkWorkerSelection100`: Create 100 workers with varied load, call PickSubject in loop
- `BenchmarkWorkerSelection1000`: Same with 1000 workers
- Setup routing with topic mapped to a pool, workers in that pool
- Use b.ResetTimer() after populating workers map
implementationPlan.note: Added BenchmarkWorkerSelection100 and BenchmarkWorkerSelection1000 via shared benchWorkerSelection helper. Uses varied load/cpu/gpu across workers in a single pool.

implementationPlan.description:
Step 3: Add BenchmarkReconcilerTick to reconciler_test.go

In `reconciler_test.go`, add:
- `BenchmarkReconcilerTick`: Create fakeJobStore with 500 DISPATCHED jobs (all with old timestamps)
- Create Reconciler with short timeouts
- Benchmark `r.tick(ctx)` in loop
- Reset job states between iterations using b.StopTimer/StartTimer
implementationPlan.note: Added BenchmarkReconcilerTick with 500 DISPATCHED jobs with old timestamps. Uses StopTimer/StartTimer to reset job states between iterations.

implementationPlan.description:
Step 4: Verify benchmarks run and existing tests pass

Run `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/... -bench=. -benchmem -benchtime=1s -count=1` to verify benchmarks execute.
Run `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/... -count=3` to verify no regressions.
implementationPlan.note: All 6 benchmarks run successfully: BenchmarkHandlePacket, BenchmarkHandleHeartbeat, BenchmarkHandlePacketWithLeastLoaded, BenchmarkReconcilerTick, BenchmarkWorkerSelection100, BenchmarkWorkerSelection1000. Existing tests pass with no regressions.
